The square filling is a torus capped along n meridians; a CW argument proves the nonequivariant wedge. Integral square-cell boundary equations show every two-cycle has unique strip coefficients, so the z_b give a primitive full-rank Z-basis. Direct tracking of the four coordinate-dihedral automorphisms proves the action. Combinatorial Alexander duality gives complete torsion-free homology. The standalone checker was executed for n=5,6,7,8 including signed integral square-cell actions; finite runs only corroborate the symbolic all-order proof.

value.rationale: The four-cycle factor is the first genuine short-period boundary of periodic ordinary three-cut complexes, and exact integral group actions on a natural full-rank homology lattice are not determined by the known non-equivariant square-filling theorem. The explicit capped-strip basis tracks rotations and both reflection signs integrally and has immediate quotient-invariant consequences. This natural complete infinite-family symmetry classification is more than numerical specialization or a known table; it complements the prior long-period torus classification.
